questions.prompt: How would you rate the severity of your knee pain during daily activities?

options.label: Mild or no pain — occasional slight discomfort
Moderate pain — uncomfortable during walking or standing
Severe pain — significantly limits daily movement
Extreme / constant pain — present even at rest or night

questions.prompt: Do you experience swelling or stiffness in your knee joint?

options.label: No swelling or stiffness
Mild stiffness in the morning or after resting
Frequent swelling after walking or physical activity
Persistent heavy swelling and severe morning stiffness

questions.prompt: Does your knee ever feel unstable, buckle, or 'give way' under your weight?

options.label: Never — joint feels completely stable
Rarely — only during sudden pivots or sports
Frequently — gives way during normal walking
Constantly — knee feels unsafe to bear weight

questions.prompt: Does your knee catch, lock, or prevent you from fully straightening your leg?

options.label: No mechanical catching or locking
Occasional clicking or popping without pain
Painful clicking or temporary catching
Knee locks completely and cannot be fully straightened

questions.prompt: How difficult is it for you to climb or descend stairs?

options.label: No difficulty — can climb stairs normally
Slight difficulty — require handrail support
Moderate difficulty — take stairs one step at a time
Severe difficulty — unable to use stairs without assistance

questions.prompt: How far can you walk before knee pain forces you to stop?

options.label: Unlimited — can walk more than 1–2 kilometres easily
Can walk 10–15 minutes before pain starts
Can walk only short distances (around house / 5 mins)
Unable to walk or require crutches / support

questions.prompt: How long have you been experiencing these knee symptoms?

options.label: Less than 2 weeks
2 weeks to 3 months
3 months to 1 year
More than 1 year (chronic condition)

questions.prompt: Have previous non-surgical treatments (medications, physiotherapy, injections) helped your knee?

options.label: Symptoms resolved or improved significantly
Temporary relief only — pain returns quickly
Minimal improvement despite physiotherapy & medications
No relief — non-surgical treatments no longer help

questions.prompt: Do you have any of the following acute symptoms or recent injury history?

options.label: None of the below — gradual age or wear related pain
Mild discomfort after long standing or exertion
Recent sports injury / sudden pop felt in knee
Inability to put any weight on leg OR swollen knee with high fever
